title: Private settlement
scope: The people who held this note before you are hidden from chain observers when settled through ZK. The person who paid you and later holders still see its history.
clearPublishes: Settling in the clear publishes the keys, signatures and amounts of everyone who held this note.

failed.retry: The server did not answer. This phone will try again.
failed.invalid: This note could not be settled privately.
